newsitem.title: UK: Britons betting on next election - in 5 years.
newsitem.headline: Britons betting on next election - in 5 years.

text.p: British gamblers are already betting on the result of the next election in five years' time.
After Labour's landslide victory on May 1, bookmakers are making the new ruling party odds-on favourite at 8/13.
The odds on the Conservatives, crushed in their worst election defeat for more than 150 years, have lengthened to 6/5.
Bookmakers William Hill said on Monday they had already taken one bet of at least 10,000 pounds ($16,000) on Labour winning the next election. ($ = 0.617 British Pounds)
